content:
A retired Laredo educator is being honored for a career spent giving back to her community. Maria Elena Hopkins is being recognized as part of this month's KGNS Plus Honors ceremony for her decades of service to Laredo, according to KGNS.

Hopkins spent 30 years as an educator. She continues that work through the Laredo Area Retired School Employee Association, supporting scholarships, book donations, and retired teachers.

Hopkins told KGNS she sees the honor as belonging to all of the association's members, and said she hopes her legacy of giving back carries on. The full story will air Tuesday night during KGNS News The Late Edition.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "KGNS Honors: Retired Laredo teacher honored for decades of service," October 26, 2026
